risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
series is close to noise; fitted weights would overfit
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~11% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The spectrum is close to white noise, so most of the variation is irregular and hard to predict. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (1 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.037), which favours a robust combination.

The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a per-horizon weighting might help, but first test a different weighting method: softmax_neg_error over full pool.
The series has high trend/seasonality but ranking is unstable; a simple mean over all models may provide a robust baseline and is a different strategy type.
Test a weighted combination on the smaller diversified pool (pool4) using inverse_error weights to see if a focused set improves performance given high outliers and unstable ranking.
try a simple mean over the diversified pool4 to see if restricting to the top 7 stable models improves robustness given the unstable ranking.
The series has unstable rankings and many correlated groups; a robust central tendency like median over the full pool may hedge against outliers and correlated errors.
The series has unstable rankings and strong seasonality; a weighted pool on the diversified pool4 with softmax_neg_error may balance models differently than inverse_error.
Ranking is unstable and many correlated groups; a forward greedy weighting on the full pool may capture complementary strengths.
Test a per‑horizon weighted combination on the diversified pool4 to exploit potential horizon‑specific strengths (feature: ranking instability, hint: robust combination).

decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9702. Series context: trend strength 0.9998 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.037); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.429.
